record.summary: Spec 072 already reports that two ready specs claim overlapping territory, which was half of what WorkScope proposed. What is left is the other half: a declaration of what one piece of work may change exclusively, what it shares, and which spec answers for each. Deferred: specified now, built when a consumer names the need.
